company.name: Tryaq
company.shortDescription: UAE-based cybersecurity company building advanced offensive and defensive solutions for individuals, enterprises, and governments.
company.description:
Tryaq (FZE) is a UAE-based cybersecurity company specializing in both offensive and defensive security solutions. We build intelligent systems that empower individuals, enterprises, and governments to understand, detect, and respond to cyber threats effectively.

Our work spans across threat intelligence, digital risk protection, and advanced investigations, combining deep technical expertise with large-scale data analytics. By merging innovation with real-world experience, Tryaq delivers practical, high-impact cybersecurity capabilities designed to protect, inform, and strengthen digital ecosystems.
